text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's been a year since we shifted Hishi Akebono's training to focus mainly on bulking.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Now, her muscles are strong enough for her to take full advantage of her towering frame.
choice_data_list: I think it's time we entered a bigger race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: There's no doubt she'll be able to unleash her full potential on the racecourse now.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Really? Yay! Which race should I run in, then?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It won't be an easy challenge for her, but we should strike while the iron is hot and take on a G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh! That's a sprint that happens on a pretty big stage, isn't it? Biko told me she's going to run in that one.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'd love to participate in it! Ooh, this is so exciting! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, a few days after our gears are set into motion for the Sprinters S…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: E-excuse me! I'm sorry to bother you right after you finished training, but I was just so impressed with your running!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: You're Hishi Akebono, correct?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A reporter writing a piece on Tracen Academy approaches Hishi Akebono.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Interesting! So as a sprinter from the upper echelons of racing, you're finally making your move!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! I sure am! "Echelons" sure sounds cool.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Is it safe to assume you'll be facing Biko Pegasus during this great surge forward of hers?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hmm, good question. I'd be really nice if I get to race against her a lot! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her responses cause the reporter to pause in surprise for a second.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Well, it sounds like the battlefront for sprinters is about to become much more interesting!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Um, may I have your permission to quote what you just said in my article?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Go right ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The online article goes live the next day and does so well that reporters line up to interview Hishi Akebono for several days on end afterward.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono's decision to join the Sprinters S. has been garnering a lot of attention.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: Considering her height, speed, and sheer power on the track, many may find it surprising who she views as her rival!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: And that is none other than Biko Pegasus, a petite fireball who runs with razor precision and has an incredible turn of foot!

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: In fact, there's a full thirty-six centimeters of height difference between them! This is sure to be an exciting race!

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: Indeed. A matchup between two athletes with such a drastic height disparity almost never happens in other sports.

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: That's what makes the Twinkle Series so much fun to watch. I'm really looking forward to this one too.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooh, this is pretty significant, huh? I definitely can't slack off now!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But right after that, the conversation takes a sudden turn.

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: I have to say, given that one of them is so tall and the other so short, it'll be quite amusing to see them standing side-by-side.

text_block_list.name: Announcer A
text_block_list.text: That's true. I think it'll be very visually striking and rather endearing to see this mismatched pair together!

text_block_list.name: Commentator A
text_block_list.text: I agree. I just have a feeling they'll be a hit with the kids, if you know what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The internet explodes with comments after that broadcast, and suddenly, everyone is talking about the two racers' height difference.

text_block_list.name: Social Media
text_block_list.text: It does make for a funny picture. Can you even call that a legit race between them? Ijbol I think I'll go just to take pictures of them. Lol
choice_data_list: (They're treating her like some circus sideshow…)

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's wrong, Trainer? You look really upset about something.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I was trying not to show my concern, but it seems my poker face needs work.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, are you hungry, maybe? I can whip up some buono snacks if you want!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: There are some carrots in the fridge, so I can make you carrot chips!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If I dodge her question, she'll only worry even more, so I give it to her straight and tell her what's worrying me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Uh-huh, I see…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: So people think it'll be funny seeing me and Biko race because I'm so big and she's so small?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whatever they might look like outwardly, at their core, they're both athletes who are taking their races seriously and chasing their dreams.
choice_data_list: I want people to take you and your races seriously.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Aww. I'm happy you feel that way, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But, you know, I think I'm lucky that fans want to come watch me at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Maybe they're only coming because they think my race with Biko sounds interesting and funny…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: But it'd be really great if they learned to love racing for real after seeing us run!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's not just anyone running either—it's me and Biko, so I'm sure everyone'll come out of it feeling full and satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono sounds so sure of herself. She has her sights set firmly forward, and her eyes don't even have a shadow of doubt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she's this resolute, then as her trainer, I should be even more so.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why? What's wrong?
choice_data_list: Let's show everyone a race they'll never forget!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Let's do our best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days later, Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus are pair running.

text_block_list.name: Bono and Biko
text_block_list.text: Raaah!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I lost at the very end… You've gotten even faster, Biko.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I'm not the only one! I was barely able to overtake you, since you were going so fast!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After that particularly lively training session…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What?! Did you say Carrot Ranger?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It turns out that Biko Pegasus's favorite hero is doing a show at the shopping district, so all of us rush to see him.

text_block_list.name: Carrot Ranger
text_block_list.text: Thank you for coming today! I hope you'll keep cheering me on, everyone!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Um… Excuse me! Carrot Ranger? I wanna become a hero just like you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Right now, I'm pouring my heart and soul into racing… When things aren't going well for me, I remember what it means to be a hero…

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And that always fills me up with energy and motivation again!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: What I mean is… I hope that you'll never give up the fight!

text_block_list.name: Carrot Ranger
text_block_list.text: Haha! Thank you! I'll never forget your kind words!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Carrot Ranger was so cool! Right, Biko?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh! Um, I…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus looks up at Hishi Akebono with a renewed fire in her eyes.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Listen, Bono. I really, really want to do well in racing!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: You know what my dream is, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Of course. You've told me about it every day since we got into Tracen!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: You dream of filling everyone with courage like a hero does through your races, right?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's right! Except… I haven't even won a single G1 race.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm so happy that I can run alongside you!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Carrot Ranger became strong thanks to her rival. And in the same way, I feel like I can work even harder as long as you're with me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Biko…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Hehe! It's the same for me too! I feel so strong and capable when I race with you!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Knowing how close you always are to overtaking me really pushes me to my limits because I don't want you to pass me!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm going to get even stronger in preparation for the Sprinters S.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: I'll make it so I'll win for sure there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems that Hishi Akebono and Biko Pegasus have become motivating catalysts for each other's growth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They bicker every time they see each other and are always silently trying to catch up with the other.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Their bond isn't easy to see, but they're both pushing each other to greater heights in their own ways.
choice_data_list: You two are great rivals for each other.
You two are great rivals for each other.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Rivals, huh?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Haha! Yeah, you're right! Biko and I are rivals!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of them set to work, preparing for their clash at the Sprinters S.
